visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A humanoid bulldog wearing a white bucket hat and green shorts with white stripes stands on a wooden platform in a sunny garden. He holds a brass trumpet to his mouth, appearing to blow into it. To his right, a television screen is set up on the platform. A figure with long black hair, dressed in a white gown, is crawling out of the TV screen towards the viewer, mimicking a famous horror movie scene. (2) The bulldog continues his posture, stationary except for slight movements. The ghost-like figure has mostly emerged from the television, resting her hands on the platform. The background is filled with green trees and bright, natural sunlight, creating a high-contrast, vibrant environment. The TV screen displays a dark, slightly flickering image with a small white icon in the center. (3) The scene cuts to a stark black background. Large white text in Traditional Chinese characters appears in the center, arranged in three rows. The top row is smaller, the middle row is the largest, and the bottom row contains a brand name. The layout is clean and informative, serving as a concluding title card for the short clip.
